A stream of molten metal pours glowing-white from a great tilting crucible into a stone mould, light flooding the cavern.
Sparks shower in a bright fan from a hammer striking glowing metal on a massive black anvil.
Rivers of molten lava glow orange across the forge floor, channeled between carved stone banks, lighting everything from below.
A roaring furnace blazes white-hot, its open mouth painting the surrounding stone walls in trembling amber light.
A newly forged blade plunges hissing into a trough of oil, dense steam billowing upward in great rolling clouds.
Leather bellows pump steadily, forcing roaring breath into the furnace heart, the coals surging brilliant yellow with each stroke.
A waterwheel-driven hammer drops in a thunderous rhythm, its iron head shaking the stone floor with every crushing blow.
Three smiths hammer a glowing ingot in perfect alternating rhythm, their strikes ringing like a deep iron bell.
Molten gold is ladled carefully into a row of small stone moulds, each one filling with trembling liquid radiance.
Glowing embers drift lazily upward through the dark cavern ceiling, tiny orange sparks spiraling into the black above.
A lava channel runs beneath iron grating, its orange glow rising through the gaps, warming the boots of every smith.
A great iron crucible tips slowly on its axle, releasing a bright roaring river of liquid copper into a waiting mould.
A smith pumps a foot-bellows rapidly, the furnace responding with a fierce whooshing surge of white and yellow flame.
A length of glowing chain is hammered link by link across the anvil horn, each strike throwing a brief starburst of sparks.
Tongs grip a red-hot ingot and plunge it back into the furnace heart, the metal vanishing into blinding white light.
A pair of smiths work a two-handled saw through cooling slag, grinding dark chunks away from a newly cast ingot.
Wheel-driven grinding stones shriek against a blade edge, a long arc of orange sparks streaming across the forge floor.
A smith pours flux powder over a weld, the joint flaring briefly brilliant white before settling back to steady orange heat.
Iron bloom is folded under a heavy hammer, its layered grain compressed with each ringing blow into a tightening dark bar.
Smoke and steam mix in the high cavern vault, lit from below by the furnace glow into shifting copper clouds.
A completed axe head is lifted smoking from the quench barrel, dark metal still ticking and hissing quietly in the cool air.
Molten slag is raked from a furnace mouth in a glowing orange heap, cooling to dull red crust at the edges.
A master smith marks a cooling blade with a steel stamp, striking once to drive the dwarven maker's mark deep into the metal.
A row of finished sword blanks leans against the cavern wall, each still faintly glowing, radiating heat in slow waves.
The great forge bellows, driven by a turning axle, exhale in long shuddering blasts that make the nearest torches gutter and bow.
